name: fmp_crypto_quote
description:
Latest quote for one cryptocurrency pair (BTC, ETH and others against a fiat currency) from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/cryptocurrency-quote as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (FMP crypto pair, e.g. BTCUSD).
For symbols use fmp_crypto_list; for history fmp_crypto_historical; the cg_* (CoinGecko) tools are an alternative source.
Example: {"symbol": "BTCUSD"}
